products.name: Resurfacing Serum
products.short_description: 10% glycolic acid. Nightly resurfacing for refined, even skin.
products.description: A gentle nightly serum formulated with 10% glycolic acid and panthenol. Resurfaces without stripping; pairs with the Hydrating Mist for a balanced routine. 30 mL.

products.name: Geranium Hand Wash
products.short_description: A botanical hand wash with rose geranium and aloe.
products.description: Daily hand wash with rose geranium, aloe, and panthenol. Foams gently, rinses cleanly. Designed for the basin you see most. 500 mL.

products.name: Hydrating Face Mist
products.short_description: Rosewater and hyaluronic acid. Sets makeup, refreshes skin.
products.description: A weightless rosewater mist with low-molecular hyaluronic acid. Use post-cleanse, mid-day, or to set powder. 100 mL.

products.name: Volume Two Cleanser
products.short_description: A gel-to-foam cleanser with green tea and amino acids.
products.description: Our second cleanser — gentler than the original, designed for daily use. Gel to foam, removes SPF and light makeup. 200 mL.

products.name: Botanical Face Oil
products.short_description: A nightly face oil with squalane, jojoba, and rosehip.
products.description: A non-comedogenic face oil pressed from squalane, jojoba, and rosehip. Two to three drops, evening only. Best applied to damp skin. 30 mL.

products.name: Eucalyptus Body Wash
products.short_description: Body wash with eucalyptus, lemon myrtle, and oat extract.
products.description: A grounded morning shower with eucalyptus and lemon myrtle. Oat extract softens; lather is generous without being squeaky. 500 mL.

products.name: Vitamin C Toner
products.short_description: Brightening toner with stable 5% ascorbic acid.
products.description: A water-light toner with 5% stabilised vitamin C and licorice root. Use morning under SPF; layer with a moisturiser. 150 mL.

products.name: Niacinamide Serum
products.short_description: 10% niacinamide and zinc. For pores and blemish-prone skin.
products.description: A pore-refining serum with 10% niacinamide and 1% zinc PCA. Twice daily, on cleansed skin. Pairs well with the Resurfacing Serum on alternate nights. 30 mL.

products.name: Amber Body Cream
products.short_description: A rich amber-scented body cream with shea and ceramides.
products.description: Our richest body cream — shea, ceramides, and a warm amber accord. Designed for after-shower or pre-bed. 200 mL jar, glass.

products.name: Restorative Lip Balm
products.short_description: Beeswax and shea lip balm. Unscented.
products.description: A simple, restorative lip balm — beeswax, shea, jojoba, vitamin E. Unscented. 12 g tin.

products.name: Calming Bath Salts
products.short_description: Magnesium-rich bath salts with lavender and chamomile.
products.description: Coarse Himalayan and Epsom salts with dried lavender and chamomile. Two scoops to a warm bath. 400 g.

products.name: Verbena Hand Cream
products.short_description: A non-greasy hand cream with shea butter and verbena.
products.description: A hand cream that absorbs in seconds. Shea butter, sweet almond oil, verbena. Carry it; reapply often. 75 mL tube.
